turns.content: I need help crafting a LinkedIn post for the Fujifilm X100VI. Here are some product facts: it has a 26.1MP sensor, a fast autofocus system, and can shoot 4K video. Can you create a post using these details?

Ready to draft the LinkedIn post.

Introducing the Fujifilm X100VI, a powerful compact camera featuring a 26.1MP sensor for stunning image quality. Capture moments with precision using its fast autofocus system, and take your creativity further by shooting in 4K video. Explore the capabilities of the X100VI today!
